# `aitbc market gpu agreement-create`

Create an AIPowerRental agreement on-chain (EVM rail) — mints the agreement_id that `aitbc dispute file` references (#2052). The buyer wallet must be authorized on the contract (`authorizedConsumers`) and the provider must be authorized (`authorizedProviders`); both are owner (Safe) calls on AIPowerRental. Legacy `createRental` is used — the protected path requires an EnergyPricing contract that is not configured on the deployed instance.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market gpu agreement-create [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider` | text | — | yes | Authorized provider wallet address (0x...) |
| `--consumer` | text | — | no | Consumer wallet address (default: signing wallet) |
| `--duration` | integer | `3600` | no | Rental duration in seconds (contract bounds apply) |
| `--price` | float | — | yes | Provider principal price in AIT (atomic units = price * 10^decimals) |
| `--gpu-model` | text | — | no | GPU model string recorded on the agreement |
| `--compute-units` | integer | `1` | no | Compute units recorded on the agreement |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name for signing (must be an authorized consumer) |
| `--wallet-path` | text | — | no | Direct wallet file path |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--yes` | flag | `false` | no | Skip confirmation prompt |
| `--json-output` | flag | `false` | no | Output raw JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market gpu agreement-create --provider <provider_address> --price <price>
```
